```yaml
name: PR Closer

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # run daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  close-prs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install gh CLI
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y gh

      - name: Install jq
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Authenticate gh
        run: echo "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" | gh auth login --with-token

      - name: Close stale PRs
        run: |
          #!/usr/bin/env bash
          set -euo pipefail

          now=$(date +%s)
          threshold=$((30 * 24 * 60 * 60))

          # Fetch all open PRs with necessary fields
          prs=$(gh pr list --state open --json number,author,createdAt,labels --limit 1000)

          echo "$prs" | jq -c '.[]' | while read -r pr; do
            number=$(echo "$pr" | jq -r '.number')
            author=$(echo "$pr" | jq -r '.author.login')
            created=$(echo "$pr" | jq -r '.createdAt')
            created_epoch=$(date -d "$created" +%s)
            age=$((now - created_epoch))

            # Skip PRs newer than 30 days
            if (( age < threshold )); then
              continue
            fi

            # Skip PRs authored by jdx
            if [ "$author" = "jdx" ]; then
              continue
            fi

            # Skip PRs labeled keep-open
            labels=$(echo "$pr" | jq -r '.labels[].name')
            if echo "$labels" | grep -q '^keep-open$'; then
              continue
            fi

            echo "Closing PR #$number (author: $author, created: $created)"
            gh pr close "$number" --comment "This PR has been automatically closed due to inactivity for over 30 days. If you wish to reopen, please comment or create a new PR." --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
          done
```
